description: Get abandoned carts from the connected store (Salla, Zid, Shopify, WooCommerce or Magento) for the last N days, with a recovery summary: how many carts were abandoned and are still open, how many were recovered (bought later), how many of those were recovered after a WhatsApp reminder, the recovery rate and the recovered value. Each cart lists the customer name and phone, total, currency, items, checkout link, store, status (open or recovered) and the WhatsApp reminders already sent. Figures match the Insights page in LetsBot. WooCommerce carts are checkouts the shopper started but did not pay. Read-only: it sends nothing. To message a shopper, use send_template with the cart's customer_phone and an approved template; do not send the same cart a second reminder if reminders_sent is already above 0 unless the user asks.

days.description: How many days back to look (1-365). Default 7.

page.description: Page number for the cart list (default: 1, 15 carts per page).

platform.description: Only this store platform. If not specified, every store that has carts is included.

status.description: Which carts to list: open (abandoned, not bought yet), recovered (bought later) or all. Default all. The summary always covers both.

name: get_abandoned_carts
